purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: What finance has actually moved onto blockchains
question: Which parts of institutional finance have actually moved onto distributed ledgers, at what level of maturity, and which title, money, collateral, accounting, failure and exit functions remain unresolved?
bluf: Institutional finance isn't moving onto one new blockchain system; it is shifting piece by piece onto a patchwork of connected, regulated ledgers, with the hardest legal and money pieces still unsolved.
evidence_cutoff_note: The controlling phase synthesis remains frozen at 2026-08-31T12:08:12-04:00. September 22 checklist, September 26 Citi audit and later dated supplements retain their own cutoffs. October 14 is the latest Citi-report reading, not a recertification of every platform or bank. The October report adds unified-inventory strategy but no new named collateral transaction or demonstrated stressed recovery. The later October 14 BNY/Citadel supplement supplies a separate named Treasury settlement-to-repo transaction; it supports part of the Citi strategy without establishing atomic digital cash, 24/7 operation or stressed substitution. The BNY operating-plan supplement checked through October 14 20:26 EDT distinguishes 2027 service aims, SEC eligibility deadlines, CCP functions and separate Fedwire clocks; the broader bank/platform snapshots retain their dates. October 14 20:38 EDT CIL supplement checks lender-side relief, start/end-leg novation, custody-control and token-admission boundaries; it is not a recertification of the full parent study. The 20:47 EDT missing-link check adds a bounded source/access ledger and distinguishes a mirror interface from an operative token and a broader clearing-hours change; no explicit tokenized-CIL join was located. October 14 21:02 EDT AppChain supplement adds the explicit BNY experiment connection and current FAQ's bounded July CCP-margin evidence; general availability, current launch quarter and BNY/CIL production joins remain unproved. Older financial-model and platform snapshots keep their dated boundaries. October 14 cross-study synthesis through 22:13 EDT connects the saved collateral and Prime credit findings to the route–anchor thesis, insurance liquidity, UK collateral questions and accounting. This is interpretation of bounded component research; it does not recertify older studies or prove one joined operating stack.
use_note: Use the maintained seven-phase answer and typed status vector. Preserve the August 31 cutoff, component-owner precedence and distinction among announced, tested, real-value, production and scaled states. The September 2 BIS verifiable-statistics note is a bounded post-cutoff supplement, not a package-wide refresh or proof of truth, legal authority, currentness, Ripple/BIS adoption or token value.

availability_semantics.public_reading: The public site contains both the original public view and a crawler-friendly static HTML reading edition. public_full_text is true.
availability_semantics.public_machine_data: The public site contains the complete positively selected structured dataset. public_full_text is true; reading_url and data_url identify the canonical JSON object.
availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. public_full_text is false and access_state is private_by_design. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
